absent: Implementation and locking contract of the namespace aware rename beyond delegation with an absent namespace.
When mount flag bits are checked or mutated and how user versus internal masks are enforced.
Pathwalk algorithm plus automount plus revalidation semantics behind the lookup modifiers.
Directory operation setup matching the closers and error pinning rules.
Netfs subrequest scheduling plus collection plus retry plus completion ordering.
Cache backend selection plus occupancy accounting plus invalidation protocol.
Writeback queue wakeup plus outstanding count lifecycle plus group release rules.
Rolling buffer mark handling plus direct vector pinning and cleanup.

findings.text: A rename helper accepts a node with a new parent and a new name and completes through a namespace aware rename using an absent namespace while propagating its integer status.

A mount handle records mnt_root with mnt_sb and mnt_flags plus mnt_idmap, where the first two are pointers to the tree entry and the superblock and the third is an integer flag word and the fourth is an identifier mapping pointer, with a randomized layout marker.

User visible mount options use MNT_NOSUID with decimal value 1 and MNT_NODEV with 2 and MNT_NOEXEC with 4 and MNT_NOATIME with 8 and MNT_NODIRATIME with 16 and MNT_RELATIME with 32 and MNT_READONLY with 64 and MNT_NOSYMFOLLOW with 128, while MNT_SHRINKABLE uses 256 and MNT_INTERNAL uses 16384.

Higher mount bits use MNT_LOCK_ATIME with 262144 and MNT_LOCK_NOEXEC with 524288 and MNT_LOCK_NOSUID with 1048576 and MNT_LOCK_NODEV with 2097152 and MNT_LOCK_READONLY with 4194304 and MNT_LOCKED with 8388608 and MNT_DOOMED with 16777216 and MNT_SYNC_UMOUNT with 33554432 and MNT_UMOUNT with 134217728.

MNT_USER_SETTABLE_MASK combines MNT_NOSUID with MNT_NODEV and MNT_NOEXEC and MNT_NOATIME and MNT_NODIRATIME and MNT_RELATIME and MNT_READONLY and MNT_NOSYMFOLLOW, while MNT_ATIME_MASK combines the three atime related members and MNT_INTERNAL_FLAGS combines MNT_INTERNAL with MNT_DOOMED and MNT_SYNC_UMOUNT and MNT_LOCKED and MNT_UMOUNT.
MAX_NESTED_LINKS denotes decimal 8 and MAXSYMLINKS denotes decimal 40.

Lookup modifiers use LOOKUP_FOLLOW at position zero and LOOKUP_DIRECTORY at one and LOOKUP_AUTOMOUNT at two and LOOKUP_EMPTY at three and LOOKUP_LINKAT_EMPTY at four and LOOKUP_DOWN at five and LOOKUP_MOUNTPOINT at six and LOOKUP_REVAL at seven and LOOKUP_RCU at eight and LOOKUP_CACHED at nine and LOOKUP_PARENT at ten.
Open related lookup modifiers use LOOKUP_OPEN at position sixteen and LOOKUP_CREATE at seventeen and LOOKUP_EXCL at eighteen and LOOKUP_RENAME_TARGET at nineteen.

Restriction modifiers use LOOKUP_NO_SYMLINKS at twenty four and LOOKUP_NO_MAGICLINKS at twenty five and LOOKUP_NO_XDEV at twenty six and LOOKUP_BENEATH at twenty seven and LOOKUP_IN_ROOT at twenty eight, with LOOKUP_IS_SCOPED combining the beneath and rooted members.

Directory mutation finalizers share a common close step. The path removal variant forwards to the creation path closer, the keep variant pins its input on success before closing and returns its input in all cases, and the plain removal variant closes without returning a value.

A network inode embeds inode first and then ops with wb_queue and _remote_i_size and _zero_point and lock and io_count and flags, plus an optional cache member when enabled, where the queue holds writeback waiters and the lock guards that queue and the count tracks outstanding operations.
Inode context bits use NETFS_ICTX_ODIRECT at zero and NETFS_ICTX_UNBUFFERED at one and NETFS_ICTX_WB_LOCK at two and NETFS_ICTX_MODIFIED_ATTR at three and NETFS_ICTX_SINGLE_NO_UPLOAD at four.
A group object holds ref with free, where the first is a reference count and the second is a release callback receiving the group itself.
Per folio metadata holds netfs_group with dirty_offset and dirty_len, where the first is an optional grouping marker and the latter two delimit a dirty range.
NETFS_FOLIO_INFO denotes decimal 1 for tagging an info pointer in folio private data, while NETFS_FOLIO_COPY_TO_CACHE denotes decimal 854 as a sentinel meaning cache only.

netfs_is_folio_info tests the tag bit while __netfs_folio_info masks it to recover an info pointer, and netfs_folio_info fetches through a folio with netfs_folio_group returning either the embedded group or the direct private value.
A folio helper establishes private two ownership with an additional reference and requires the marker to be clear on entry.

netfs_io_source distinguishes NETFS_SOURCE_UNKNOWN with NETFS_FILL_WITH_ZEROES and NETFS_DOWNLOAD_FROM_SERVER and NETFS_READ_FROM_CACHE and NETFS_INVALID_READ and NETFS_UPLOAD_TO_SERVER and NETFS_WRITE_TO_CACHE, stored in a single byte.

A stream tracks construct with sreq_max_len and sreq_max_segs and submit_off and submit_len and submit_extendable_to plus prepare_write and issue_write for submission, alongside subrequests with collected_to and transferred and error and source and stream_nr plus avail and active and need_retry and failed and transferred_valid for collection and state.

Cache context holds ops with cache_priv and cache_priv2 plus debug_id and inval_counter, where the first is an operation vector and the next two are opaque tokens and the last two record identity and invalidation state.

A subrequest links rreq with work and rreq_link and io_iter plus start and len and transferred and ref and error and debug_index and nr_segs and retry_count and source and stream_nr and flags, covering supervision with iteration and progress and identity and retry state.

Subrequest bits use NETFS_SREQ_COPY_TO_CACHE at zero and NETFS_SREQ_CLEAR_TAIL at one and NETFS_SREQ_MADE_PROGRESS at four and NETFS_SREQ_BOUNDARY at six and NETFS_SREQ_HIT_EOF at seven and NETFS_SREQ_IN_PROGRESS at eight and NETFS_SREQ_NEED_RETRY at nine and NETFS_SREQ_FAILED at ten.

netfs_io_origin orders NETFS_READAHEAD with NETFS_READPAGE and NETFS_READ_GAPS and NETFS_READ_SINGLE and NETFS_READ_FOR_WRITE and NETFS_UNBUFFERED_READ and NETFS_DIO_READ for reads before NETFS_WRITEBACK with NETFS_WRITEBACK_SINGLE and NETFS_WRITETHROUGH and NETFS_UNBUFFERED_WRITE and NETFS_DIO_WRITE and NETFS_PGPRIV2_COPY_TO_CACHE plus a trailing count, stored in a single byte with the cache copy member deprecated.

A request starts with a cleanup union with work and inode and mapping and iocb plus cache_resources and copy_to_cache and an optional process link, followed by io_streams sized by NR_IO_STREAMS with group and buffer marked by NETFS_ROLLBUF_PUT_MARK and NETFS_ROLLBUF_PAGECACHE_MARK plus waitq and netfs_priv and netfs_priv2.

The same request continues with direct_bv and direct_bv_count and direct_bv_unpin plus submitted and len and transferred and progress_at and error and i_size and start, then issued_to with collected_to and cleaned_to and abandon_to and no_unlock_folio plus gfp and debug_id and rsize and wsize and subreq_counter and nr_group_rel and lock and origin and ref and flags with netfs_ops.

NR_IO_STREAMS denotes 2 with NETFS_ROLLBUF_PUT_MARK mapping to the first rolling mark and NETFS_ROLLBUF_PAGECACHE_MARK to the second, while request bits use NETFS_RREQ_IN_PROGRESS at zero and NETFS_RREQ_ALL_QUEUED at one and NETFS_RREQ_PAUSE at two and NETFS_RREQ_FAILED at three and NETFS_RREQ_RETRYING at four and NETFS_RREQ_SHORT_TRANSFER at five and NETFS_RREQ_OFFLOAD_COLLECTION at eight and NETFS_RREQ_NO_UNLOCK_FOLIO at nine and NETFS_RREQ_CANCEL_CACHING at ten and NETFS_RREQ_UPLOAD_TO_SERVER at eleven and NETFS_RREQ_USE_IO_ITER at twelve and NETFS_RREQ_NEED_PUT_RA_REFS at seventeen and NETFS_RREQ_USE_PGPRIV2 at thirty one with the last deprecated.

A request operation vector supplies request_pool with subrequest_pool plus init_request and free_request and free_subrequest for lifecycle, then expand_readahead with prepare_read and issue_read and is_still_valid and check_write_begin and done for reads, plus update_i_size with post_modify for attributes, and begin_writeback with prepare_write and issue_write and retry_request and invalidate_cache for writes.
NETFS_READ_HOLE_IGNORE with NETFS_READ_HOLE_FAIL are the two hole policies for cache reads.

A cache operation vector ends operations through end_operation and moves data through read with write and issue_write using termination callbacks, adjusts coverage through expand_readahead with prepare_read and prepare_write_subreq and prepare_write, and locates cached extents through query_occupancy.
An accessor recovers the enclosing network inode from its embedded VFS inode.

Remote size and zero point pair release stores with acquire loads on common builds, sequence counter retry on thirty two bit multiprocessing, and preemption suppression on thirty two bit preemptible builds, with a combined snapshot covering local size plus remote size plus zero point under the same scheme.
The inode spinlock serializes wb_queue while the request spinlock serializes subrequest queuing.

Request state uses in progress with all queued and pause and failed and retrying and short transfer plus offload collection and no unlock folio and cancel caching and upload to server and use iterator and need put readahead refs with a deprecated private marker, governing generation suspension with retry paths and completion offload.

Subrequest state combines cache copying with tail clearing and progress and boundary and end of file and in progress and need retry and failed, while stream state combines avail with active and need_retry and failed plus transferred_valid for the validity of the transferred count.

Establishing private two ownership faults when already marked, the cache only sentinel must never be dereferenced as a live group, and the deprecated page private markers must not anchor new behavior.
mempool_t aliases a memory pool object while netfs_io_terminated_t denotes a callback receiving an opaque token with a transferred count or error.
